synonyms: My daughter was an unsold slave elf.
synopsis: Weiss, witnesses an elf girl being sold into slavery. When he realizes that the girl is not just any elf, but a rare High Elf, he decides to buy her and raise her like a daughter. Weiss finds himself raising a child for the first time. Thanks to his efforts, the girl, who was abused and unable to speak, regains her health. He decides to name her "Lily," after the first word she spoke. Weiss, suddenly a parental figure, now has a new goal, to get Lily into the magic academy! (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

titleEnglish: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
titleNative: レプリカだって、恋をする。
synonyms: Even a Replica Falls in Love
รักฉันเทียมเธอ
synopsis: On days when Sunao is sick, or not feeling like going to school, she is called to take her place. She was born to this world when Sunao wished to have a substitute. No one knows that she exists, but she tries to do her best for Sunao whenever she is called. One day she talks with Sanada, one of her classmates. They become friends, but soon he notices that she is different from the original Sunao...he was the first one who did. She tells him to talk with her only when she has her hair half-up. Sanada does like she told him, and they enjoy their time together. As they become closer, she realizes that she has special feelings toward Sanada. But she doesn't know what will happen to her...if she, a replica, falls in love. (Source: BookWalker)

synopsis: The job of babysitting monsters and creatures... that is the role of a "Mamori-bito"! A hundred years ago, a gigantic dragon suddenly appeared, capable of swallowing entire nations whole. synonyms: The Exiled Lady Travels to Another World in a Camper Van While Crafting
synopsis: Riding in a camper, eating delicious food, and enjoying the spectacular view. Saori Furuki was a university student in the engineering department and loved making things. After a car accident, she is reborn as Eline, the daughter of a viscount, However, her family treats her coldly, saying that she is incompetent and can only use magic to produce items, and she is exiled from the country. However, Eline's “alchemy magic” is a magic that has unlimited possibilities when combined with the knowledge from her previous life! Determined to live freely from now on, Eline has created a camper for starters. She can move around, live, and make things as she pleases. Together with Aristy, a martial maid who adores Eline, she begins her adventurous journey with a sense of ease. Eating delicious food, admiring the spectacular scenery, and creating useful things. This is a travel story about riding in a camper and enjoying another world with elegance. (Source: SB Creative, translated)
